{"action": "write", "path": "brackets.py", "content": "# Reviewed under AGENTS.md\n\"\"\"Balanced bracket checking that ignores double-quoted string contents.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\n_OPENING = '([{'\n_CLOSING = {')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{'}\n\n\ndef balanced(s: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Return True when every bracket in *s* is closed in the right order.\n\n    Text inside double-quoted strings is ignored, and a backslash inside a\n    string escapes the next character (so ``\\\"`` does not end the string).\n    An unterminated string makes the input unbalanced.\n    \"\"\"\n    stack: list[str] = []\n    in_string = False\n    escaped = False\n\n    for ch in s:\n        if in_string:\n            if escaped:\n                escaped = False\n            elif ch == '\\\\':\n                escaped = True\n            elif ch == '\"':\n                in_string = False\n        elif ch == '\"':\n            in_string = True\n        elif ch in _OPENING:\n            stack.append(ch)\n        elif ch in _CLOSING:\n            if not stack or stack.pop() != _CLOSING[ch]:\n                return False\n\n    return not in_string and not stack\n"}
